data.question: Blind Dolphins are found in the river of:
data.description: The Gangetic dolphin, also known as the "blind dolphin", is found in the Ganges River of India and Bangladesh. It is functionally blind due to its murky, silty environment, having eyes with no lenses. Instead of vision, it relies on a highly developed echolocation system of clicks and pulse sounds to navigate and hunt in the river's low-visibility conditions.
